sentences.en: Put the meat in the refrigerator, or it will rot.
sentences.zh: 把肉放进冰箱里，不然会坏掉。

sentences.en: I wonder if there's any cheese left in the refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 我想知道冰箱里还有没有奶酪。

sentences.en: I want some milk, but there isn't any in the refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 我想喝牛奶，但冰箱里没有了。

senses.zh: 冷冻机, 冷藏库, (电)冰箱, 制冰机
